title: "Bad Grammar": Russian-linked Telegram comment activity
summary: OpenAI banned accounts linked to a previously unreprorted Russia-origin operation we dubbed "Bad Grammar", using AI to generate English- and Russian-language Telegram comments on Ukraine, Moldova, Baltic, and US politics.
body: OpenAI banned accounts linked to a previously unreprorted Russia-origin operation we dubbed "Bad Grammar", using AI to generate English- and Russian-language Telegram comments on Ukraine, Moldova, Baltic, and US politics.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布封禁了与名为“Bad Grammar”的俄罗斯相关虚假信息行动有关的账户。这些账户利用AI生成英语和俄语评论，针对乌克兰、摩尔多瓦、波罗的海国家及美国政治进行舆论干预。该事件凸显了AI大模型在自动化生成多语言政治内容方面的潜在威胁，以及平台方在打击此类滥用行为上的治理力度。
